messages.content:
In two or three sentences, explain why a household AI lab might choose to
run a large language model locally on its own hardware instead of only
using a hosted API, even though the hosted API is usually cheaper per
token.

message.content: Running a model locally keeps all data and prompts on the household's own hardware, eliminating the privacy and sovereignty risks of sending sensitive information to a third-party server. It also removes dependence on network availability and vendor rate limits, giving the lab full control over latency, uptime, and the ability to fine-tune or modify the model without external constraints.
